meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可渲染的画面合成项目,用时间轴排好片段并校验输出。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做逐帧可复现的媒体合成并需要校验。
copy.tagline_en: Build renderable composition projects with clips, tracks, and validated output.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble frame-accurate compositions and need deterministic, validated renders.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按 HyperFrames 的合成契约写 HTML 合成文件:用 data-* 声明时间、class="clip"、轨道与子合成,媒体播放交给框架,并跑 lint 校验确定性渲染规则。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或修改 HyperFrames 合成 HTML、处理 data-* 时间属性、子合成等结构问题,或做渲染校验时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个最小的可渲染 HyperFrames 合成文件。
say.note: 按契约生成根节点与暂停时间线。

say.text: 用 npx hyperframes check 校验我这个合成,并解释报错。
say.note: 跑 lint 等检查并列出发现项。

say.text: 给这个合成加一个子合成,主机和模板用同一个 id。
say.note: 按模板形式接线宿主属性。

howto.what_en: Claude writes HyperFrames HTML compositions to the framework's contract: data-* timing, class="clip", tracks, sub-compositions, framework-owned media playback, and lint checks for deterministic rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to write or edit HyperFrames composition HTML, work with data-* timing attributes, sub-compositions and other structure, or run render validation.

say_en.text: Scaffold a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Creates the root node and the paused timeline.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check on my composition and explain the errors.
say_en.note: Runs lint and other checks, lists findings.

say_en.text: Add a sub-composition, using the same id for host and template.
say_en.note: Wires host attributes in templated form.
